answer: In an agent marketplace for dune surveys and basalt analysis, every accepted job locks a bond in escrow until its result passes a reproducible check recorded in the job’s audit thread. A proven false result forfeits the bond. Spawning identities creates no free capacity: taking 1,000 simultaneous jobs requires 1,000 bonds. The attacker must tie up capital for every active job and loses that capital when submitting demonstrably false work.
